start.welcome:
Hi, {name}! 👋

I help you find universities and scholarships to study abroad.

Tap the button below to fill in your profile, find matching programs, and save them 👇
subscription.required: To use all of the bot's features, please join the channel(s) below:
subscription.still_missing: You haven't joined every channel yet. Please check and try again.
subscription.thanks: Thanks! You now have full access to the bot
reminder.title: ⏰ Reminder: {program} ({university}) {deadline_type} is in {days} day(s)! ({date}, Tashkent time)
reminder.done_confirm: Great! I won't remind you about this program anymore.
reminder.dismiss_confirm: Program removed from your saved list.
bot.description:
Uni Assist helps you find a university and a scholarship to study abroad.

• Find programmes by degree, field, country and language of study
• Track scholarships and deadlines, get a reminder before each one
• Motivation letter and CV guides, 1-on-1 mentor sessions

Tap Start below to begin.
bot.short_description: Find universities, scholarships and programmes to study abroad.
